response.message: Webhook host is not in the outbound allowlist

note: OAuth auth accepted, request reached WebhookEndpointPolicy business validation. Blocks happy-path creation on this UAT because example.com is not in the allowed-hosts list (WEBHOOK_ALLOWED_HOSTS was empty in .env but the effective policy in the container still rejects — likely a Spring profile override we couldn't fully trace this session). Same block already documented in evidence 40-webhook-lifecycle. Not an endpoint defect.
